value: Darion takes the last relic to his own father: Alexandros' soul shard. The returned fragment lets the two speak again. Alexandros tells him that the Lich King tormented him and tried to bind him to Frostmourne, but the memory of Darion's sacrifice held him from surrender. Darion answers that he would give his life for his father a thousand times. Among the ruin left by Frostmourne, their family history rises into a brief reunion.
editorNote: Research status: the cited quest/item mirrors support this original paraphrase, but original Wrath client/build capture and human lore review remain required. Do not infer a canonical player, exact cross-story date, exact return-NPC placement, or later Arthas outcome.
